hypothesis: Training MSE improvements failed in later years; strictly prior-year validation may reject overfit fixed Ridge10 coefficients. Isolate forecast regularization selection without new features, horizon changes or portfolio-gate changes.
ridge_penalty_units: SSE plus alpha times squared slopes, unpenalized intercept; alpha is not divided by n
selection_protocol: For outer yearY, fit all inner candidates only on H5 labels/features strictly before Jan1(Y-1)ET. Score only signal yearY-1 rows whose labels matured strictly before Jan1(Y)ET. Scaler and perasset variance come only from inner training. Never use outer Y labels or portfolio returns.
selection_metric: mean over SOXL/SOXX of validation MSE divided by inner-training label variance(ddof0)
tie_rule: exact score ties only; no added economic threshold
refit: After selecting candidate, refit it using all strictly mature data before Jan1(Y). Control alwaysRidge10 using identical outer rows. If selectedRidge10, reuse exact control fit.
prior_definition: Forecast of training H5 mean with intercept-only BartlettHAC5 covariance; it is not the investment portfolio SOXX null. Its allocations/turnover/fees remain subject to the same actual solver and gate.
gate_definition: Unchanged full2016-2022 paired SOXX gates at both costs: positive net log excess,>=6/7positive years,positive annualmedian,positive afterremovinganyyear,MaxDD/CVaR no worse,rolling252win>=60%,20/60block lower>0. One outer selected pipeline; prior project search and model-refit uncertainty not removed by conditionalbootstrap.
execution: Prior-signal16:15ET decision,nextopenexecution,daily nextopen valuation,H5maturityexit09:31,solve every5native sessions andexactHOLDbetween. Same-SOXXestimatedriskbudget atrebalance only. Existing certified numerical protocol; no terminal liquidation,cash0yield,continuousshares.
label_precision: Same float64 daily/H5 labels from identical canonical native opens, with oldcausal25feature recipe.
stopping: One registered nested-selection mechanism with all four inner forecasts and all annual scores retained. No alpha/horizon/feature additions after results. Failure leads to separate cause diagnosis and preregistered next mechanism, not closure of user goal.
limitations: All history reused, no independent forward qualification.
A prior forecast may still cause active allocations; choosing prior is not proof of alpha or automaticSOXX holdings.
One prior validation year is noisy and regimes can change; no promise of generalization.
H5labels overlap; strict maturity removes crosscutoff leakage but not all estimation dependence.
